method_boundary: All rows checked internally against stored source registers and generated selections. External live reads were spot checks only, not a fresh re-read of every source.

findings.finding: The previous calculation used +8 v +2. The cited scores are Nemo 1-15 to 0-16 and St Finbarr's 2-12 to 0-16, both two-point wins. The basis and generated row now use +2 v +2; the selection remains low confidence.

Six outright summaries used an event name or a blank opponent instead of the leading golfer, runner or driver; four also inverted the leading probability. Summaries now equal their primary selection. Three-way summaries use draw-inclusive probabilities.
The Gaelic row's numeric olbg_event_id=14 had no corresponding event URL in the stored capture or source register. It was removed. A live read of that constructed URL returned 'No tips found.'

findings.item: Current OLBG listing coverage is not established
findings.finding: Only 1 of 93 rows retains a recorded OLBG event id with a matching registered URL, and its live re-read returned 'No tips found.' The integration therefore confirms zero currently readable active OLBG listings. The other rows are official-context fixtures, not claimed OLBG listings.
48 fixture rows have no confirmed venue and remain blank across 6 sports. No venue has been inferred. Each affected row and its official source is enumerated below.

The target is met for 2 of 15 sports (Basketball, Rugby League). There are 35 high-confidence and 11 medium-confidence write-ups in total; medium write-ups are not counted toward the high-confidence target.

findings.item: NHL published comparison prices moved after the stored capture
findings.finding: The live schedule still listed both NHL fixtures as FUT with the stored teams, starts and venues. Provider 8 showed Montréal -170 / Chicago +138 in the integration read, while the 20:05Z record stored -169 / +137. The desk's own probabilities were not changed; its historical comparison prose remains tied to the earlier capture.

findings.item: Historical desks are not consolidated into current counts
findings.finding: Older overlapping desks retain their own stale taxonomy, prose and source-link findings. They are preserved for audit, not added to the current 93-row snapshot. The existing 16-findings repository audit remains linked from the current desk.

findings.item: Cork official participant ordering differs between sources
findings.finding: Cork GAA lists Nemo Rangers v St Finbarrs, while the stored Munster source string and generated row list St Finbarr's v Nemo Rangers. The final is at a neutral venue; no home/away designation is inferred and the underlying 48% low-confidence selection mapping is unchanged. The ordering discrepancy remains explicit for manual review.

external_spot_checks.result: NHL JSON retrieved. Games 2026020166 and 2026020167 were FUT with the stored participants, UTC starts and venues. Provider 8 prices had moved as described in FI-07.
OLBG page retrieved; the event area displayed 'No tips found.' No active market or listing was inferred.
OLBG page retrieved; it displayed 'No tips found.' and did not identify the Cork final.

Cork GAA page retrieved; it listed Nemo Rangers v St Finbarrs on 25 October at 16:00 and the two semi-final scorelines used in FI-01. Its participant order differs from the stored Munster source string, as disclosed in FI-09.
Cork GAA fixture page independently listed the same final, venue and referee David Murnane.
